content.value_statement: Researchers often need precise data availability text, repository plans, and FAIR checks before submission. This skill turns English or Chinese data notes into Nature-style statements, dataset citation actions, and missing-information flags.
actual_capabilities: Drafts Nature-style Data Availability statements from manuscript data notes.
Maps generated, reused, restricted, and supplementary datasets to access routes.
Suggests repository and identifier strategies for common research data types.
Flags missing DOIs, accessions, licences, embargo details, and weak request-only wording.
Prepares DataCite-style dataset citation actions and FAIR metadata checks.
Supports Chinese input and returns English text with Chinese confirmation notes.
limitations: It cannot create real DOIs, accession numbers, repository records, or licences.
It depends on accurate author input about data, restrictions, and ethics approvals.
It does not replace legal, ethics, funder, or journal office review.
It should verify current journal policy pages when rules may have changed.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Submission Statement
use_cases.description: Turn dataset notes into a ready-to-paste Data Availability section with repository and citation actions.

use_cases.title: Audit Data Sharing Gaps
use_cases.description: Check whether each dataset has a durable access route, metadata, licence, and clear restriction logic.

use_cases.title: Convert Chinese Data Notes
use_cases.description: Transform Chinese availability wording into precise English and list the fields authors must confirm.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Simple Statement
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with a small dataset.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a Nature-style Data Availability statement. My data are in Zenodo with DOI [DOI], and source data are in Supplementary Table 1.

prompt_templates.title: Map Several Data Sources
prompt_templates.prompt: Map these datasets to access routes, then draft the statement: generated sequencing data [accession], reused public data [source], and figure source data [location].

prompt_templates.title: Revise Weak Wording
prompt_templates.scenario: Submission audit before sending a paper.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Data Availability statement for Nature readiness. Flag weak claims, missing identifiers, missing restrictions, and needed dataset citations.

prompt_templates.title: Handle Restricted Data
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with sensitive or third-party data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a controlled-access Data Availability statement. Include privacy reason, metadata route, access committee, eligibility, data-use agreement, and public summary data.

output_examples.input: A paper has raw imaging data in Dryad, source data in supplementary files, and no restricted data.
output: A Data Availability section that names the Dryad record and supplementary source files.
Repository and citation actions for the Dryad dataset reference.
Missing-information flags for licence, version, and figure-to-file mapping.

output_examples.input: A Chinese note says data are available from the corresponding author due to privacy.
output: An English controlled-access statement with privacy basis, access route, and review conditions.
A Chinese confirmation list for ethics approval, data-use agreement, and access committee details.

output_examples.input: A study reused public climate data and generated processed analysis tables.
output: A statement that separates reused public data from generated processed tables.
Dataset citation actions for public sources, versions, and dates accessed.

best_practices: Give the skill a dataset inventory before asking for final wording.
Provide repository names, identifiers, licence terms, embargo dates, and restriction reasons.
Ask for a FAIR audit before submitting the statement.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent DOIs, accessions, licences, or ethics approvals.
Do not rely on available upon request without a clear restriction and access process.
Do not use it as the final authority for legal, privacy, or journal policy decisions.

faq.question: Does this skill write final manuscript text?
faq.answer: Yes. It drafts ready-to-paste Data Availability text when the needed dataset details are available.

faq.question: Can it help Chinese-speaking authors?
faq.answer: Yes. It accepts Chinese notes, drafts English submission text, and adds Chinese confirmation points.

faq.question: Does it choose repositories?
faq.answer: It suggests repository patterns and identifier needs. Authors must confirm journal, funder, and repository requirements.

faq.question: Can it handle restricted human data?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft controlled-access wording with privacy reasons, review routes, and access conditions.

faq.question: Will it verify live policy pages?
faq.answer: It reminds users to verify current journal pages when policy details may have changed.

faq.question: Does it generate real accession numbers?
faq.answer: No. It flags missing identifiers and asks authors to deposit data or provide verified repository records.
